fire: The envelope had two paper flaps tucked neatly under the seal.
Horses were grazing with mud splashed on their flanks after the rain.
The pastry chef folded the dough into thin flaps before baking.
The tent had canvas flaps that rolled up during the day.
Wolves circled the herd and attacked its flanks at dusk.
The pilot lowered the wing flaps for the final approach.
Grey fur covered the cat's flanks and belly in winter.
The soldiers moved quietly along the enemy's eastern flanks.
